simple.meaning: עָגִיל (ʻâgîyl) is a Hebrew word meaning “something round , i.e. a ring (for the ears).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עָגִיל (H5694) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 31:50, with occurrences in Numbers, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָגִיל (H5694) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עָגִיל (H5694) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עָגִיל (ʻâgîyl) / H5694 is traced through Numbers 31:50, Ezekiel 16:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
